$comment: Browser probes (tests/browser/*.browser.mjs) red on the released pair as well as on the candidate: pre-existing, each with its owning unit and what it says. scripts/run-browser-probes.mjs reads this file: a failure named here is reported under failed with known: true and counted apart (knownRed), not as a new red; a named probe that passes again is listed under knownNowPassing, to be taken out. The run still exits 1 while any probe fails, known or new: the list says which reds are not the candidate's, it does not make them green. Taken by the group build 18 pre-cut (DEV msg-5ee6d5bacd684276a776, answer 8); triage of each entry belongs to its owner.
